implemented_capabilities.capability: Certified max-flow with exact Dinic repair, min-cut extraction, flow decomposition
implemented_capabilities.notes: Pure Python. Validates a FalkorDB algo.maxFlow result for feasibility, conservation and residual-maximality; if it fails, re-solves with Dinic. Written specifically because FalkorDB 4.22 algo.maxFlow returned non-maximal flow in a documented repro.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Independent proof checker (Menger: k disjoint routes + k-edge cut)
implemented_capabilities.notes: Never computes a flow; verifies claimed path set and cut. claims.json reports 333 checker accepts, 0 rejects, 734 FalkorDB first-pass-exact sweeps (self-reported).

implemented_capabilities.capability: Single points of failure, all minimum cuts, critical pairs (N-2), N-1 table, reliability polynomial, Monte Carlo with Wilson CI
implemented_capabilities.notes: Picard-Queyranne enumeration of every min cut with Tarjan SCC + topo order; exhaustive failure-set search capped at 2^16 facility subsets; k==1 SPOF identified by removing each on-route lift and re-running exact max-flow.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Network-wide N-1 impact via dominator trees (Cooper-Harvey-Kennedy) on contracted zone graph, plus repair sequencing by exact DP over subsets
implemented_capabilities.notes: network.py claims it cross-checks the dominator result against a plain search witness(); sequence.py does DP over 2^C repair orders (C<=10) and reports greedy gap. Only header/docstrings were read in full detail, bodies sampled.

implemented_capabilities.capability: What-if closure simulation on graph copies (GRAPH.COPY) with idempotent desired-state sync
implemented_capabilities.notes: Closure is a relationship-type swap SF <-> SF_CLOSED; base/demo/live/wi_* graphs; what-if copies are LRU-limited (2) and deleted at exit. assess() returns LOSS / ENTRANCE_ONLY / NO_LOSS / CANNOT_ASSESS.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Dijkstra reroute with per-edge live-graph certificate (deliberately avoids algo.SPpaths)
implemented_capabilities.notes: Documents that FalkorDB 4.22 SPpaths ran ~8h and ignored TIMEOUT; routes in Python and re-verifies each edge with indexed MATCH.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Incident memory with first_seen/last_seen/ongoing/ended_by and alert version counts; frozen demo scope
implemented_capabilities.notes: (:Lift)-[:CLOSED_IN]->(:Incident) from captured MBTA alert versions; demo scope is as-of a frozen_at cutoff; explicitly states nothing is inferred about actual lift status.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Grounded LLM agent over MCP tools with deterministic router fallback and replay-digest verification
implemented_capabilities.notes: LLM only chooses tools and phrases the answer; answer is rejected unless every id/number appears in tool results; replay.verify re-executes recorded tool calls and reports digest drift. draft_action only drafts a ticket (filed=false).

graph_models_and_cypher: Labels: Node (with sub-labels Platform, Lift, Street), Station, Lift, Incident, Meta. Edges: SF (single step-free relationship type; parallel edges merged because algo.maxFlow in 4.22 accepts exactly one relationshipTypes entry and rejects parallel edges), SF_CLOSED (closure swap), STEP, RIDE, DEPENDS_ON (baseline sole-lift dependency), DEPENDS_NOW (recomputed under closures), CRITICAL_PAIR, CLOSED_IN. All Cypher is fixed named constants in lastlift/queries.py with $params; the single dynamic one is Q_CREATE_DEPENDS.format(rel='DEPENDS_NOW') with a code constant. Uses FalkorDB-specific procedures: algo.maxFlow (certified afterwards), db.idx.fulltext.queryNodes, GRAPH.COPY, ro_query. Does NOT use APOC/GDS. Pinned to FalkorDB 4.22 behaviours (comment notes pattern predicate inside CASE failing on 4.22).
algorithms: Dinic max-flow with super source/sink and residual-reachability certificate in lastlift/flow.py:exact_maxflow/certify/repair
Min-cut extraction and unit-path flow decomposition in lastlift/flow.py:min_cut/decompose
Picard-Queyranne all-min-cuts via SCC condensation + closed-set enumeration in lastlift/cuts.py:all_min_cuts
Exhaustive minimal failure-set search (SPOF, critical pairs, N-2) and exact reliability polynomial in lastlift/cuts.py:Failures
Dominator-tree N-1 journey-break analysis in lastlift/network.py
Exact DP repair-order optimiser (2^C subsets, C<=10) with greedy gap in lastlift/sequence.py
Dijkstra reroute + edge-by-edge certificate in lastlift/routing.py
backend_interfaces: FastAPI lastlift/main.py: GET /healthz, /v1/health, /v1/queries, /v1/queries/{id}/plan, /v1/tools, POST /v1/tools/{name}, GET /v1/stations/{id}/graph, /v1/live, /v1/disclaimers, POST/GET /api/ask (SSE events per contracts/ask_events.schema.json)
MCP server mounted at /mcp (FastMCP) exposing the tool registry
scripts/*.py CLI sweeps (network_sweep, backtest, history_replay, verify_claims, smoke)
frontend_interfaces: React 18/TS/Vite app web/src: pages Landing, Station, Network, Repairs, About; components AgentDrawer, ProofPanel, XRay, KState, HistoryPanel, Announcer (screen-reader), axe-core Playwright a11y spec
agent_or_memory_mechanisms: Tool-calling agent loop (max 3 tool rounds, then tool_choice none) with provider failover chain (Groq qwen -> gpt-oss-120b -> Gemini flash-lite), daily call/token caps, W3C traceparent spans, rule-based router fallback when no LLM, grounding validator G1-G6, recorded replays with canonical SHA-256 digests re-verifiable against the live graph. 'Memory' is the incident log (CLOSED_IN) not conversational memory.
tests_present: tests/ 17 files, ~114 test functions (flow, checker/chain, routing, network, tools, agent, snapshot, history, memory, guard, wording, preregistration, web). Includes an expected-failure live repro of the FalkorDB maxFlow bug and NetworkX oracles. Also web/tests/a11y.spec.ts and CI workflow (.github/workflows/ci.yml, runs secret_scan). Not executed by auditor.
dependency_requirements: dev: networkx==3.7, pytest==8.4.2, jsonschema==4.26.0, pyyaml==6.0.3, pyarrow==26.0.0 (history ingest only)
security_findings: lastlift/queries.py:~Q_CREATE_DEPENDS and lastlift/state.py:71 - Cypher built with str.format(rel=...) but the relationship name is a code constant ('DEPENDS_NOW'), not user input.
lastlift/agent/llm.py:84 - outbound httpx.post with Authorization: Bearer from env keys (GROQ/GEMINI); keys come from env or ../.env (config.py _load_env_file), none hard-coded.
lastlift/live.py:37 - outbound httpx.get to MBTA API (optional x-api-key).
lastlift/config.py:42,72 - GITHUB_TOKEN setting is loaded but grep found no use in lastlift/ (draft_action never files); dormant credential plumbing.

lastlift/main.py:198-208 - POST /v1/tools/{name} executes any registered tool with caller args; arg names are allow-listed, no auth in this file (ALLOWED_ORIGINS CORS only). what_if creates server-side graph copies (resource-exhaustion vector, mitigated by LRU of 2).
docs/falkordb-sppaths-note.md - algo.SPpaths ignores TIMEOUT on 4.22 and can pin all server threads; any Kairos code must not call it.
No eval/exec/pickle/subprocess in lastlift/ runtime; subprocess only in scripts/secret_scan.py (git hooks tooling).
No hard-coded secrets found; .env.example has empty values; scripts/secret_scan.py actively blocks secret-shaped strings.
duplicates_or_overlaps: Overlaps with blast-radius / single-point-of-failure analysis (generic network-resilience engine), what-if contingency simulation and repair prioritisation (Operational Optimization). The certified-flow + proof-checker approach is unique in this batch and directly relevant to making FalkorDB 4.22 graph-algorithm results trustworthy.
evidence_drift_relevance: MEDIUM - agent/replay.py re-executes recorded tool calls and flags digest drift, incidents.py keeps versioned alerts with first_seen/last_seen/ended_by under a frozen as-of cutoff, and DEPENDS_ON vs DEPENDS_NOW exposes newly-single dependencies; however there is no dependency-invalidation cascade, supersession model or approval gate.

strongest_reusable_unit.why: Three small, dependency-free Python modules that turn any directed capacity graph into certified min-cuts, single points of failure, critical pairs, reliability numbers and a machine-checkable proof, and that defend against the documented FalkorDB 4.22 algo.maxFlow defect - exactly the server version Kairos targets.
strongest_reusable_unit.external_runtime_needed: none for flow/cuts/checker (edges are plain (eid,u,v,cap) tuples); FalkorDB 4.22 only if you also want to cross-check algo.maxFlow

strategy_rationale: flow.py/cuts.py/checker.py are domain-neutral resilience algorithms that can be lifted into a Kairos shared engine (blast radius, SPOF, critical-pair, N-1/N-2). The MBTA data model, ingest and UI are domain-specific and should stay as a reference/optional pack.
